world.headline: Cruise Ship Evades Pirate Attack Off Somalia
world.description: The Seabourn Spirit, a Seabourn Cruise Line cruise ship, evaded an attack by pirates off the coast of Somalia. The ship used a Long Range Acoustic Device to deter the attackers.

world.headline: 400th Anniversary of the Gunpowder Plot
world.description: The 400th anniversary of Guy Fawkes' attempt to blow up the Houses of Parliament with King James I inside was commemorated across Britain.

religion.headline: Pope Benedict XVI Prepares Seminary Restrictions
religion.description: Pope Benedict XVI prepared to enact new rules restricting homosexual men from entering the seminary, a response to the Catholic Church sex abuse scandal.

science.headline: Ancient Christian Church Discovered in Israel
science.description: Archaeologists in Israel discovered a rare early Christian church dating to circa AD 300. The church was uncovered near the prison at Megiddo.

entertainment.headline: The Red Green Show Airs Final Episode
entertainment.description: The final episode of The Red Green Show aired, ending at exactly 300 episodes at the end of season 15.

notableDeaths.headline: John Fowles, English Novelist, Dies
notableDeaths.description: John Fowles, the acclaimed English novelist known for works such as The French Lieutenant's Woman and The Collector, passed away at age 79.

notableDeaths.headline: Link Wray, Pioneer Guitarist, Dies
notableDeaths.description: Link Wray, the American singer-songwriter and guitarist credited with inventing the power chord and influencing punk rock, passed away at age 76.

spaceAndAstronomy.headline: Venus Express Launched by ESA
spaceAndAstronomy.description: The European Space Agency launched Venus Express on November 9, 2005, Europe's first mission to Venus, from Baikonur Cosmodrome aboard a Soyuz-Fregat rocket.

spaceAndAstronomy.headline: Hayabusa Spacecraft Arrives at Asteroid Itokawa
spaceAndAstronomy.description: JAXA's Hayabusa spacecraft arrived at asteroid 25143 Itokawa in September 2005 and made its first landing attempt in November 2005, becoming the first mission to return samples from an asteroid.

india.headline: India's Economy Growing Rapidly
india.description: In 2005, India's GDP growth rate was approximately 9.3%, marking one of the fastest growth periods in the country's economic history.

sports.headline: India vs Sri Lanka Cricket Series Underway
sports.description: In November 2005, India was engaged in a cricket series against Sri Lanka, one of several sporting events during the month.

technology.headline: Xbox 360 Launched
technology.description: Microsoft launched the Xbox 360 on November 22, 2005, marking the beginning of the seventh generation of video game consoles.
